story_title: OpenAI Frontier Models and Codex Launch on AWS
caption:
OpenAI frontier models and Codex are officially live on AWS. ☁️⚡️

For years, deploying leading AI models in large enterprises required navigating single-provider channels or custom multi-cloud workarounds. OpenAI's expansion to AWS brings frontier models straight into existing enterprise controls, security environments, and procurement budgets.

Swipe through for the breakdown of what this means for enterprise AI architecture.

—

alt_text_overall: Carousel graphic breaking down OpenAI frontier models and Codex becoming available on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: OPENAI JUST LANDED ON AWS.. For years, deploying OpenAI in enterprise settings meant specific vendor pipelines. That dynamic just shifted completely. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: NO MORE MULTI-CLOUD FRICTION.. OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available directly within AWS, bringing frontier AI straight to where existing workloads live. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: BUILT FOR EXISTING AWS WORKFLOWS.. Companies can now use existing AWS security controls, governance policies, and procurement channels to run OpenAI frontier models and Codex. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: FROM EVALUATION TO PRODUCTION.. Instead of running experimental models outside standard infrastructure, teams can now scale directly within their primary enterprise cloud. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
Slide 5: MODEL ACCESS IS NOW MULTI-CLOUD.. The era of locking top-tier frontier models behind single cloud channels is officially closing. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR BUILDERS.. For developers and enterprise architects, infrastructure choice wins. You no longer have to restructure your cloud stack just to access leading models. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 7: THE CLOUD AI WAR JUST ENTERED A NEW PHASE.. When frontier AI meets native enterprise cloud infrastructure, implementation speed becomes the ultimate competitive advantage. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
